name: cc-profiles
description: Multi-model profile management and orchestration for Claude Code

plugins.name: cc-profiles
plugins.description: Create isolated Claude Code profiles for different AI providers (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, OpenRouter, etc.) and generate orchestration prompts for multi-model collaboration. Includes slash commands /profile-add, /profile-list, and /profile-activate, plus an auto-triggered skill for profile management.
